product_metadata.title: ZYLISS Classic Rotary Cheese Grater
features: Rotary cheese grater works quickly to grate more cheese in less time
Stainless-steel drum accommodates hard cheese, chocolate, and nuts
Sturdy plastic housing; ergonomic grip; stores compactly in a cupboard or drawer
Removable parts for fast cleanup; dishwasher-safe
Measures approximately 6-1/2 by 3 by 5 inches; 5-year limited warranty
description: Turn a cumbersome job into an effortless task with help from this modern twist on the traditional cheese grater. Uniquely designed for tableside use while enjoying pasta, salads, and other dishes, the unit works quickly to grate more cheese in less time, thanks to its ingenious rotary technology. To use, simply place cheese inside the grater's roomy hopper and position it over a tray or plate. Firmly squeeze the grater with one hand, rotating the handle with the other hand to create mounds of finely grated cheddar, parmesan, and more. Equipped with a durable stainless-steel drum, the unit not only tackles even the hardest of cheese with ease, but it can also be used to grate chocolate shavings for topping cream pies, nuts for sprinkling over salads, and more. Best of all, the drum and handle remove easily for quick cleanup when through. Additional highlights include an ergonomic grip for comfortable use, sturdy plastic housing, and a sleek design that stores compactly in a utensil drawer or cupboard. Great for everyday use and entertaining alike, the dishwasher-safe rotary cheese grater measures approximately 6-1/2 by 3 by 5 inches and carries a five-year limited warranty.
